purpose: Verify that E1 + E2 + E3 now behave coherently as one bounded, trustworthy continuity layer.

design_rules.core_rule: E4 is a closure-proof step, not a feature-expansion step.
design_rules.judgment_rule: Judge whole-layer coherence, not feature count.
design_rules.reflection_first_rule: Main reflection must remain primary throughout.
design_rules.boundedness_rule: Continuity must remain light, restrained, and non-memory-first.
design_rules.silence_rule: Silence remains a valid success state when support or value-add is weak.

acceptance_statement: The system can help one repeated inner pattern become visible, remain legible, become clearer, and fade appropriately without becoming heavy, intrusive, or memory-first.
required_checks: one repeated inner pattern can emerge credibly
that pattern can remain legible lightly across time
that pattern can become clearer without becoming heavier
that pattern can decay quietly when support weakens
the product still reads as a continuity layer, not a history/tracking/memory-first layer
E1 + E2 + E3 behave coherently as one bounded layer
governance_checks: no hidden accumulation driving visible behavior

output_shape_for_nova.task: E4 implementation coherence and founder-demo support
must_return: evidence that no hidden feature creep was introduced
